_readme: Hand-kept corrections for scripts/build_people.py. 'exclude' keeps a person off the automatic lists: key is a Wikipedia title (as in the article URL, underscores) or a Wikidata QID, value is the reason. 'include' adds a person the build would not: {date: 'MM-DD', list: 'historic'|'living', name, title, y (birth year), d (death year or null), w (short descriptor), sl (Wikipedia language editions, used only to order the list)}. Edit this file, then run: python3 scripts/build_people.py --assemble-only

exclude.Eva_Braun: Hitler's partner; excluded with the Nazi leadership
exclude.Joseph_Stalin: responsible for the Great Purge and mass deportations and famines
exclude.Hassan_Nasrallah: Hezbollah leader; designated a terrorist organization by the US and EU
exclude.Qasem_Soleimani: IRGC commander; designated a terrorist by the US
exclude.Slobodan_Milošević: indicted by the ICTY for war crimes; died before a verdict
